viewing_check: Check whether the top tilts and is one piece or has a split or old repair, look for leg joint cracks or loose legs, veneer lifting, water rings and sun fade. Check the timber on an unpolished edge underneath (cedar vs mahogany) and the table top diameter. Photograph the underside and the leg-to-column joins.
